# Farwa Beauty Salon

> Women-only beauty salon in Block 3 PECHS, Karachi, Pakistan, founded by Rubina in 2008.
> 13 specialities, 102 services, every starting price published. Rated 4.5/5 on Google (35 reviews, verified 2026-10-30).
> Studio visits only — one PECHS branch; no home services / at-home visits.

## Key facts

- Legal / trading name: Farwa Beauty Salon
- Founder: Rubina (lead beautician)
- Address: Plot 165/G-1, Saima Terrace, Block 3, PECHS, Karachi 75400, Pakistan
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 322 278 2254 (https://wa.me/923222782254)
- Hours: Monday-Saturday 11:00am-7:00pm, closed Sunday
- Online booking: https://farwasalon.com/book (free cancellation up to 2 hours before)
- Payments: cash, JazzCash, EasyPaisa (no cards)
- Clientele: women only — no men's services
- Quote-only (WhatsApp photo for a binding quote): keratin treatment; party makeup — no printed floor on the menu
- Not offered: HydraFacial, laser hair removal, home parlour visits, other branches
